headline: Williams Sonoma (WSM) Stock May Be A Bargain On Cash Flow But Rich On Earnings
summary: Williams-Sonoma stock has delivered a very strong 244.2% return over the past three years, yet its valuation signals are mixed, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to roughly 16.0% upside while earnings based multiples lean expensive. Together with a low overall value score, that split raises questions about how much of the recent share price strength is already pricing in optimistic assumptions.
